sourceSteps: 坐在地板上，双腿伸到身前。
稍微向后倾斜，将双腿抬离地面，保持伸直。
同时，将上半身抬离地面，并将手臂伸向腿部。
保持这个姿势几秒钟，然后慢慢降低上半身和双腿回到起始位置。
sourceImageLicense: Original Zeno artwork; no upstream exercise media used.
reviewObservation: Held V-sit with pelvis/sit bones on floor, long backward-leaning torso, both straight legs lifted together and both arms reaching forward without floor support. Full feet visible, readable open V, tail extends behind to one side without propping torso.
